text:
alex kim: Hey payroll team — my end-of-quarter bonus posted today but it hit my UK GBP account and got converted then taxed at source. I moved to the US (payroll country US) in Jan; pay profile shows USD direct deposit. Can someone check why bonus was paid in GBP? trx 0xBONS123. Last 4 acct 4321. Thanks.
people-ops: Sorry about that. Can you confirm which bank account is default in your Payroll profile and whether you added a new IBAN? Also did you file any tax residency change?
alex kim: Profile shows USD ACH ending 4321. I did submit the relocation form on Jan 12 and updated my address. On the stub it says `Bonus — UK gross`.
jamal: @alex kim thanks. Do you have the paystub screenshot? If it says gross in GBP then likely the bonus was run under a legacy EMEA payroll batch. We'll escalate to the payroll vendor and request an off-cycle correction. Can you DM the stub? :+1:
alex kim: Uploaded the stub to DM. The tax line shows PAYE 20% and employer NI withheld — looks like UK taxes applied.
people-ops: We'll flag for manual reversal. Two notes: (1) if correction is issued in USD, taxes must be reconciled — could be a reclaim from HMRC or an adjustment on the next run, (2) if HMRC already collected, the reclaim process can take 6-8 weeks. We'll keep you posted.
sofia: FYI — we need to confirm your tax residency docs. If you were UK tax resident on the payment date, employer may be obligated to withhold. Payroll should check migration date vs payment date.
payroll-bot: Off-cycle reversal request submitted (#OC-9876). Estimated processing: 3 business days for reversal, up to 60 days for HMRC reclaim.
jamal: I'll confirm with the vendor that the bonus should have been USD. If reversal can't recover HMRC withholding, we'll consider gross-up or credit depending on policy. @people-ops can you confirm gross-up policy for cross-border mispays?
people-ops: Policy: for vendor errors causing tax withholding we cover reasonable tax remediation (reclaim attempts first; if unsuccessful, case-by-case gross-up). We'll route to total comp for approval.
alex kim: Thanks. One more Q: will the reversal change my year-to-date tax in ADP/PeopleSoft? I need the corrected YTD for my mortgage docs.
jamal: Yes — final YTD will reflect the reversal. We can provide an interim statement for the mortgage underwriter if needed.
people-ops: Noted. @alex kim we'll send a confirmation email once OC-9876 completes. Apologies again :raised_hands:
